text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
On the eve of the Flower Festival,
Suzume is captured as a hostage by the gang.
However, neither {0} nor Ryuuji were aware of that fact.
text_block_list.orig_text:
花祭りの前夜。スズメはギャングに人質として捕らえられてしまう。
しかし、{0}もリュウジも、
そのことに気付いていないのだった。

text_block_list.name: リュウジ
text_block_list.text:
結局、
ボスは約束の場所に現れなかった……
もしかして、
この村から手を引いたのか？
text_block_list.orig_text:
結局、
ボスは約束の場所に現れなかった……
もしかして、
この村から手を引いたのか？

text_block_list.name: Ryuuji
text_block_list.text:
The village is quiet for now.
I'd be thrilled if it ended like that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
村も今のところは静かなもんだし。
このまま終わってくれりゃ、
万々歳なんだが。

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Ryuuji-san.
Are you already working this morning?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おはようございます、
リュウジさん。
もう朝の作業に入ってるんですか？

text_block_list.name: Ryuuji
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Kyouka and the boy. 
What are you doing here so early in the morning? 
You could have slept longer, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
キョウカと優男か。
そっちこそ
こんな早くからどうしたんだ、
もっと寝ててもよかったんだぞ？

text_block_list.name: Ryuuji
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, I haven't seen her.
Aren't you guys together?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あん？　
いや、
見てねぇけど。
お前らと一緒じゃないのかよ。

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Last night, she told me to go to bed first
because she was preparing the laundry, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
昨晩、
お洗濯の準備をしてから寝るので、
先に寝ててほしいって言われたんですけど……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
After that, it seems like she didn't return to the room. 
She always wakes up before me and wakes me up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その後、
部屋に戻ってないみたいなんです。
いつも私よりも早起きで、
起こしてくれるのに。

text_block_list.name: Ryuuji
text_block_list.text:
She say she was going to prepare the laundry last night, right? 
What's going on with the laundry now?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいつ、
昨日の夜の間に
洗濯の準備をするって言ってたよな？
洗い物は今、
どうなってる？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit strange.
It was left scattered everywhere.
And there were even petals scattered about...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それも、
ちょっとおかしくて。
あちこちに散らかったままにしてあったんです。
花びらまで舞い散ってて……

text_block_list.name: Ryuuji
text_block_list.text: ...Let me take a look.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ちょっと見せてみろ。

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Here it is.
It seems like a different type of flower to the ones planted in the village.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これです。
村に植えてあるお花とは、
違う種類みたいなんですけど。

text_block_list.name: Ryuuji
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, shit!
Did you set the monster on the girl!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずいぞ、
クソッ！
化け物を嬢ちゃんにけしかけたのか！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Huh, um, what do you mean by "monster"?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
あの？
化け物ってなんの話ですか？

text_block_list.name: Ryuuji
text_block_list.text:
…… I guess I have to tell you everything after all!
Come with me, we also need to ask the old man for help!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
やっぱり
全部話すしかねぇ！
ついてきてくれ、
じじぃにも助けを借りる必要がある！

text_block_list.name: Suzume
text_block_list.text:
Hey～! Please let go of me!
Why are you doing this～!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの～！
放してください、
どうしてこんなことするんですか～！？

text_block_list.name: The boss of the gang
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh, once I'm done with this,
I'll take care of you anyway. 
I'll tell you so you can take it with you to the afterlife.
text_block_list.orig_text:
クックック、
お前は用事が済んだら始末するしな。
冥途の土産に教えてやろう。

text_block_list.name: The boss of the gang
text_block_list.text:
We will attack the village soon.
However, no matter how poor and weak your opponents are,
you'll take losses if you attack head-on.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これから私たちは村を襲撃する。
だが、
いくら相手がド田舎の貧弱な農民だからって、
真正面から攻めれば数で負ける。

text_block_list.name: The boss of the gang
text_block_list.text:
However, if they scatter searching for you...
Won't it be easier to deal with them?
You are a guest, and the villages trusts you, the village chief cannot ignore that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかし、
お前を捜すために連中が散り散りになったら……
始末するのが楽になると思わないか？
ゲストで信頼も厚いお前を、
村長だって放置はできまい。

text_block_list.name: Suzume
text_block_list.text:
Did you kidnap me for something like that?! 
You're trying to take advantage villagers's kindness!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなことのために、
私をさらったんですか！？
村の人たちの優しさを、
利用しようとするなんて！

text_block_list.name: The boss of the gang
text_block_list.text:
Winning is all that matters, winning!
Once we take care of all the villagers, next are the tourists.
We'll make effective use of all the remaining valuable items and crops!
text_block_list.orig_text:
勝てばいいんだよ、
勝てば！
村の連中を全員始末したら、
次は観光客共だ。
残った金目の物や作物は、
全て我々が有効活用してやる！

text_block_list.name: The boss of the gang
text_block_list.text: ... In particular, the soil in this village is perfect for mass-producing this "monster plant"
text_block_list.orig_text:
……特に、
この村の土壌は、
この『魔物植物』を量産するのにうってつけだしな！

text_block_list.name: Monster plant
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Suzume
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's the monster that attacked me yesterday...!
But why are you listening to what humans say!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
私を昨日襲った魔物ですね……！
でも、
どうして人間の言うことを聞いてるんです！？

text_block_list.name: The boss of the gang
text_block_list.text:
Are you curious!? I'll tell you about that too!
It requires a long training period or talent to control monsters,
but this one has been genetically modified and quickly becomes obedient to humans!
text_block_list.orig_text:
気になるか！？　
それも教えてやろう！
魔物を従えるのには
長い訓練期間か才能が必要だが、
こいつは品種改良され、
すぐ人間に従順になる！

text_block_list.name: The boss of the gang
text_block_list.text:
After Ryuuji messed up,
it was worth the trouble to steal the seeds!
Hahaha～!
text_block_list.orig_text:
リュウジのヤツが下手を打った後も、
苦労して種を盗み出した甲斐があったというものだ！
ふははは～！

text_block_list.name: Monster plant
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Suzume
text_block_list.text:
If there were many more of these,
it would be a big problem!
I have to do something about it, right!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
こんなのがいっぱい増えたら、
大変なことになっちゃいます！
なんとかしないと～！？

text_block_list.name: Village Chief
text_block_list.text:
... So you were being threatened by the gang,
and keeping quiet about the fact that the village was being threatened by dangerous demon plants?
And as a result, Suzume-san was kidnapped.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……つまりお前は
ギャングに脅されていて、
村に危険な魔物植物が迫っていることを黙っていたんだな？
しかもその結果、
スズメさんをさらわれてしまったと。

text_block_list.name: Ryuuji
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's all my fault... I'll accept any punishment later!
But first, please help me look for the young lady!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
全部俺のせいだ……
後でどんな罰でも受ける！
でもまずは、
嬢ちゃんを捜すのを手伝ってくれ！

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
Mayor, you won't abandon Suzume, right...!?
Neither Suzume nor Ryuuji are at fault!
It's the gang members who did this cowardly act!
text_block_list.orig_text:
村長さん、
スズメを見捨てたりしないよね……！？
悪いのはスズメでもリュウジでもない！
卑怯なことをしたギャングの方だよ！

text_block_list.name: Village Chief
text_block_list.text:
I want you to feel at ease, of course I will lend a hand.
If something were to happen,
I wouldn't be able to face Saren-san.
text_block_list.orig_text:
安心してほしい、
もちろん人手を出すよ。
万が一のことがあれば、
サレンさんに顔向けできない。

text_block_list.name: Ryuuji
text_block_list.text: Old man...
text_block_list.orig_text: じじぃ……

text_block_list.name: Village Chief
text_block_list.text:
Did you feel torn because of your feelings for the village?
To be clear, your judgment was wrong,
but the blame lies with the one who threatened you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前も、
村を想って板挟みだったのだろう？
ハッキリ言って判断は間違っていたが、
悪いのは脅した方に決まっておる。

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Village Chief...!
If we search with a large group, we should definitely find them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとうございます、
村長さん……！
大勢で捜せば、
きっと見つかるはずです！

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
I have to help before something terrible happens to them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！
酷いことされる前に、
助けてあげなきゃ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to ask the Nightmare for help!
I'll trust the others with the search,
but it's best to be prepared just in case!
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分は
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】に応援を頼んでくるッス！
捜索は
他の人任せになっちゃうッスけど、
いざってときに備えた方がいいッス！

text_block_list.name: Village Chief
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'll count on you then. 
Now, men, search for Suzume-san! 
Bring weapons, like hoes or scythes, too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、よろしく頼むよ。
さぁ、
男衆はスズメさんの捜索だ！
クワでも鎌でもいい、
武器になるような物も持っていけ！

text_block_list.name: Men of the village
text_block_list.text: Oh!!
text_block_list.orig_text: おぉ！！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Let's go too!
We can hold off on the Flower Festival a little while longer.
We absolutely must bring back Suzume-san!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちも行きましょう！
あともうちょっとで
花祭りを開催できるんです。
絶対に、
スズメさんを連れ戻さなきゃ！

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.orig_text: うん！

text_block_list.name: Gang member 1
text_block_list.text:
Boss, the villagers have started to move.
As expected, it seems they plan to split up and search.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボス、
村の連中が動き始めました。
予想通り、
手分けして捜索するつもりのようです。

text_block_list.name: Gang Underling 2
text_block_list.text: For now, it seems like there are some kids who came as guests mixed in...
text_block_list.orig_text:
一応、
ゲストで来てたガキどもも混じってるようですが……

text_block_list.name: The boss of the gang
text_block_list.text:
Is it just a numbers game now? We're well prepared for something like this.
Deal with them the same way as the villagers.
However, do not kill the village chief or Ryuuji, bring them here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうせ数合わせだろ？　
なんかこう、
上手いことやっとけ。
村の連中と同じように対処すればいいだろ。
ただし、
村長とリュウジは殺さずここまで連れてこい。

text_block_list.name: The boss of the gang
text_block_list.text:
I want to confirm the whereabouts of the village's assets
and we need to settle things with Ryuuji.
... Don't you think so?
text_block_list.orig_text:
村の財産の在り処を確認したいし、
リュウジとはケジメもつける必要がある。
……
お前もそう思うよな？

text_block_list.name: Monster plant
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Male Villager
text_block_list.text: The petals of the monster plant you mentioned seem to be leading towards the forest.
text_block_list.orig_text:
例の魔物植物の花びらは、
森の方に続いていってるみたいだ。

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Surely, Suzume-san is hidden deep in the forest!
If she were in the village, she'd be found out right away.
text_block_list.orig_text:
きっと、
森の奥にスズメさんを隠してるんです！
村の中だと、
すぐにバレちゃいますから。

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
But in the end, they're leaving behind flower petals and being careless.
This gang is as clumsy as Suzume.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
結局花びらを残してるし、
うっかりしてるね。
スズメに負けないくらい、
ドジなギャングなのかも。

text_block_list.name: Gang member 1
text_block_list.text:
Little girl,
you shouldn't make fun of adults so much.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お嬢ちゃん。
あんまり大人を馬鹿にしちゃいけないなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Gang Underling 2
text_block_list.text: Especially adults that have weapons.
text_block_list.orig_text:
特に、
武器を持ってる大人はよぉ？

text_block_list.name: Ryuuji
text_block_list.text:
You bastards!
All of you...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
出やがったな！
てめぇらまとめて……！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Please wait! 
The reason these people came out is because
they found out that we're looking for them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
待ってください！
この人たちが出てきたのは、
私たちが捜しに来てることがバレてるからです！

text_block_list.name: Male Villager
text_block_list.text:
We've no choice, let's split into two groups!
We'll handle these guys ourselves!
You guys hurry and find Suzume-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
仕方ない、
二手に分かれよう！
こいつらは俺たちで何とかする！
君たちは
スズメちゃんの元へ急ぐんだ！

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text:
Even though they're trying to act cool,
they're just amateurs when it comes to fighting, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
『なんてカッコつけてるけど、
おっさんたち、
戦いに関しちゃ素人なんだろ？』

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
I will stay and fight too! 
I'm worried about Suzume,
but I know I can leave it to Onii-chan and you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私も残って戦うよ！
スズメのことは心配だけど、
お兄ちゃんたちになら任せられるから！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Ayane-san!
Leave this to us, let's go ahead first!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すみません、
アヤネさん！
ここは任せて、
先に向かいましょう！

text_block_list.name: Ryuuji
text_block_list.text: I'll repay the favor, make sure you stay safe!
text_block_list.orig_text:
恩に着るぜ、
無事でいろよな！

text_block_list.name: Gang member 1
text_block_list.text:
Letting a kid handle it and trying to run away,
looks like you've fallen far, Ryuuji!
You think I'd let you go that easily...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ガキに任せて逃げようなんざ、
落ちたなリュウジ！
そんな簡単に行かせるわけ……

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text: Puukichi～......Full swing!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぷうきち～……
フルスイ～ング！！

text_block_list.name: Gang member 1
text_block_list.text: Blargh!?
text_block_list.orig_text: ぶぺらっ！？

text_block_list.name: Gang Underling 2
text_block_list.text:
What, what is this girl!?
Wasn't this supposed to be just a simple numbers game!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんだこいつ！？
ただの数合わせって話じゃなかったのかよ！？

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
Mister,
you shouldn't make fun of children so much, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おじさん。
あんまり子どもを馬鹿にしちゃいけないよ？

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text: Especially, a child who has a massive hammer!
text_block_list.orig_text:
『特に、
デカいハンマーを持ってる子どもはな！』

text_block_list.name: キョウカ
text_block_list.text:
はぁ……！
早く、
スズメさんを見つけないと……！
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……！
早く、
スズメさんを見つけないと……！

text_block_list.name: Ryuuji
text_block_list.text: Damn, if only I had asked for help earlier...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
クソ、
俺がもっと早く相談してりゃ……！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Yes! 
If you're going to apologize...
Please get Suzume-san back and apologize to her in person!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうです！
謝るなら……
スズメさんを取り戻して、
本人に謝ってください！

text_block_list.name: Ryuuji
text_block_list.text:
I understand...!
Okay, the amount of petals is increasing... We're almost there...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かってるよ……！
よし、
花びらの量が増えてきてる……
もうすぐだ……！

text_block_list.name: The boss of the gang
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Ryuuji has arrived!
It seems that my underlings are busy dealing with the villagers.
Honestly, this is why you want strong and obedient pawns.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふはははははは！　
来たか
リュウジ！
どうやら部下たちは村の連中の対処で手一杯のようだな。
まったく、
これだから強くて従順な駒が欲しくなる。

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... uh, anyway, Suzume-san was able to get free!
And the bad guy was also defeated!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええっと……
と、
とりあえずスズメさんは解放できました！
悪い人もやっつけられましたし！

text_block_list.name: Suzume
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for being clumsy and holding you back until the end...
If I hadn't been caught, it might have been easier to deal with...
text_block_list.orig_text:
最後まで、
ドジで足引っ張ってすみま
せん……
私が捕まってなかったら、
もっと
簡単に
対処できたかもしれないのに……

text_block_list.name: Ryuuji
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see.
It was not the boss's fault, I was too indecisive. I should have relied on the people around me without being scared of threats.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、そうだ。
悪いのはボスと……
フワフワ迷ってた俺だ。
脅しにビビらず、
ちゃんと周りを頼ればよかった。

text_block_list.name: Monster plant
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Ryuuji
text_block_list.text:
Well, now that we have the little lady Suzume...
Let's have this guy make his exit!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて、
それじゃスズメの嬢ちゃんもそろったところで……
こいつにはご退場願おうか！

text_block_list.name: Suzume
text_block_list.text:
{0}!
Please strengthen me too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さん！
私にも
強化をお願いします！

text_block_list.name: Suzume
text_block_list.text:
I can feel your power inside me!
Alright then, Kyouka-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
力が湧いてきましたよ～！
それじゃあ、
キョウカちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Let's work together and defeat them!
With both of our magic, ready, set...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい！
連携してやっつけましょう！
二人の魔法で、
せ～のっ
……

text_block_list.name: Suzume & Kyouka
text_block_list.text: This is your punishment!!
text_block_list.orig_text: お仕置きです！！

text_block_list.name: Monster plant
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Ryuuji
text_block_list.text:
It's effective, but can't beat it!
I brought the oil thinking the fire would work,
If the magic earlier didn't work, it's going to be tough...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
効いちゃいるが、
倒しきれねぇか！
火が効くと思って油は持ってきてるんだが、
さっきの魔法でダメなら厳しいぞ……！

text_block_list.name: Ryuuji
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a bag of fertilizer?
Probably some lazy idiot forgot to clean up,
but what's this supposed to be good for...
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっと、
肥料の袋？
多分、ズボラなバカが片付け忘れたんだろうが、
こんなもんなんの役にも……

text_block_list.name: Ryuuji
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is that what you meant!
Mix the fertilizer with oil... Okay!
Now all that's left is to wait for him to open his mouth again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
待て、
そういうことか！
肥料を、
油と混
ぜて……
よし！
あとはもっぺん、
あいつが口を開けるのを待つだけだ！

text_block_list.name: Monster plant
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Ryuuji
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
You monster, I'll give you some more!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よっしゃ！
化け物め、
お代わりをくれてやるぜ！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Ryuuji, what did you throw in!?
It was eaten in one bite...
text_block_list.orig_text:
リュウジさん、
何を投げ込んだんです！？
一口で食べられちゃいましたけど……

text_block_list.name: Ryuuji
text_block_list.text:
I borrowed the girl's clumsiness! 
Anyway, just give it one more shot like earlier!
text_block_list.orig_text:
嬢ちゃんのドジを借りたのさ！
とにかく、
もう一発さっきのをかましてくれ！

text_block_list.name: Suzume
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me!
With cleaning magic... Ei!
text_block_list.orig_text:
任せてください！
お掃除魔法で……
え～い！

text_block_list.name: Monster plant
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Suzume
text_block_list.text:
Whaagh～!?
What an unbelievable explosion～!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひゃあああ～！？
とんでもない爆発です～！？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Could it be that you've been thinking a lot about when we burnt weeds and trash...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかして、
雑草やゴミを焼いたときの……
よく思いつきましたね？

text_block_list.name: Ryuuji
text_block_list.text:
It was all thanks to the boy that I came up with it.
Really, she's a klutz but he knows how to use it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
思いついたのは優男のおかげだけどな。
本当に、
ドジも使いようだぜ。

text_block_list.name: Suzume
text_block_list.orig_text: ……はい♪
